changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO person_notifications (person_id, notifications) SELECT DISTINCT own_sick_note.person_id, 'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_SICK_NOTE_ACCEPTED_BY_MANAGEMENT_TO_USER' FROM person_notifications own_sick_note WHERE own_sick_note.notifications = 'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_SICK_NOTE_SUBMITTED_BY_USER_TO_USER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person_notifications accepted WHERE accepted.person_id = own_sick_note.person_id AND accepted.notifications = 'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_SICK_NOTE_ACCEPTED_BY_MANAGEMENT_TO_USER' );
